name: vibey
description: krypton for VS Code: drive vibey and a local gpt-oss model from your editor, or a vibey hub on your network. Runs on your own computer; no account and no cloud.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Ask the local model to do something in this folder. It works on a copy, so nothing changes until you choose Apply.
[Ask the model](command:vibey.ask)
[Run a folder of tasks](command:vibey.runBatch)
[Show every command](command:vibey.showMenu)
[Take the one-minute tour](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22the-vibey-project.vibey%23krypton.firstRun%22)

No lanes are running on this computer right now.
[Ask the model](command:vibey.ask)

Projects come from vibey on this computer, or from a vibey hub on your network.
[Connect to vibey on this network](command:vibey.connectHub)
[Take the tour](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22the-vibey-project.vibey%23krypton.firstRun%22)

vibey.cliPath.markdownDescription: The `vibey` program to run. Empty: the first `vibey` on your PATH. **krypton: Check my setup** prints the one it found and its version.

vibey.gptossloopPath.markdownDescription: The `gptossloop` program, the local engine that runs a task on gpt-oss:20b by default. Empty: the first `gptossloop` on your PATH. It ships with vibey (`pip install vibey-engine`).

vibey.qwenloopPath.markdownDescription: The `qwenloop` program: the same local runner on a Qwen model, which runs only once vibey switches it on (`VIBEY_FEATURE_QWENLOOP=1`, ADR-0064). Empty: the first `qwenloop` on your PATH.

vibey.ollamaPath.markdownDescription: The `ollama` program, used only to start a server with `ollama serve` and to show a download command. Empty: the first `ollama` on your PATH.

vibey.gitPath.markdownDescription: The `git` program. Empty: the first `git` on your PATH.

vibey.vibeySkillsPath.markdownDescription: The `vibey-skills` program that builds context packets for the **Plugins** menu. Empty: the first `vibey-skills` on your PATH.

vibey.ollamaUrl.markdownDescription: Where Ollama listens, in root form without `/v1`. Empty: `$VIBEY_OLLAMA_URL`, else `http://127.0.0.1:11434`.

vibey.ollamaAppPath.markdownDescription: macOS only: the Ollama app **Start Ollama** opens when it exists. Otherwise `ollama serve` is started.

vibey.model.markdownDescription: The model gptossloop tasks run on. Empty: `$VIBEY_OLLAMA_MODEL`, else `gpt-oss:20b`. qwenloop is not handed this: its own config chooses (`qwen3:14b`), unless you name a model with the engine, `qwenloop/qwen3:14b`.

enumDescriptions: Your own computer: free, private, always available (the default, sub-doctrine 8.b).
Paid vendors: they bill their own accounts, so this needs a one-time declaration with a budget.
vibey.loop.markdownDescription: Which loop runs tasks. `paidloop` works only after you declare it once (**Choose the loop**), with a daily or monthly dollar budget.

vibey.effort.markdownDescription: How hard the engine works (vibey's own effort levels). `auto` starts at **Base effort** and climbs one step each time a task fails, as vibey's escalation ladder does, never past a budget. `ULTRA` has no turn limit and is shown in its own colour with a flame.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Start at **Base effort** and climb one step each time a task fails, never past a budget.
The least work: one small change.
The most a bounded run does.
Effort without a ceiling (ADR-0063): no turn limit, and a finished pass is a checkpoint before the next improvement pass. It stops only at **Stop** or a declared budget cap.

vibey.baseEffort.markdownDescription: Where `auto` effort starts: vibey's BUILD phase starts at `LOW`.

vibey.engine.markdownDescription: `auto` picks within the loop by effort (preferring a model already loaded). Or name an engine, `gptossloop`, or an engine and model, `gptossloop/gpt-oss:20b`. The engines come from `vibey loops`.

vibey.maxTurns.markdownDescription: The most model turns one task may take, used only when neither the task file (`max_turns`) nor the effort sets one. `0`: none from here.

vibey.contextWindow.markdownDescription: The context window, in tokens, the local runner (gptossloop or qwenloop) assumes (its own `context_window`, default 32768). **Check my setup** warns when Ollama loaded the model with a smaller one, because Ollama then drops the start of long tasks without saying so.

vibey.runInPlace.markdownDescription: Run tasks directly in the open folder instead of in a separate copy (a git worktree on its own branch). **Off is safer**: with it on, the model edits your files as it goes and there is no Apply or Discard.

vibey.baseRef.markdownDescription: The git branch or commit a task's copy starts from. Empty: whatever you have checked out (`HEAD`).

vibey.stormHome.markdownDescription: Where task copies, plans and records are kept. Empty: `$VIBEY_STORM_HOME`, else `~/git/vibey-storm` on macOS and `$XDG_DATA_HOME/vibey/storm` (or `~/.local/share/vibey/storm`) on Linux. A folder your computer empties at restart is refused (sub-doctrine 10.h).

vibey.modelLockPath.markdownDescription: A lock directory that keeps runs on the same computer from sharing the model at once, including runs started from a terminal with `vibey-vscode`. Empty: the lock the computer declares with `VIBEY_OLLAMA_LOCK` (the one vibey-gh and storm tooling share), else `.ollama-lock` in the storm home. A lock held by something that does not say who is never broken.

vibey.maxConcurrentRuns.markdownDescription: How many tasks may use one model at the same time. Further tasks wait in line. `1` is the measured best on a 24 GB Mac: at two, answers drifted from what one run gives (structural fidelity 0.82, under the 0.95 floor; #1114, sub-doctrine 8.c).

vibey.refreshSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the Model, Projects and Gates views refresh themselves.

vibey.pollMilliseconds.markdownDescription: How often a running task's event log is read for new lines.

vibey.stuckHintMinutes.markdownDescription: After this many minutes without a new event, a running task shows a hint. Nothing is ever stopped for being slow: on a 24 GB Mac one turn of gpt-oss:20b took 16.5 s typically and 112.6 s at the 95th percentile.

vibey.forceStopAfterSeconds.markdownDescription: How long a graceful **Stop** is given before **Force stop** is offered. A force stop is only ever a person's choice, and it is written in the journal.

vibey.lanesRecentMinutes.markdownDescription: The Lanes view lists lanes with an event in this many minutes.

vibey.skillsBudget.markdownDescription: The token budget of a vibey-skills context packet (vibey's own bounds: 1,000 to 32,000).

vibey.budgetInputTokensPerTurn.markdownDescription: Input tokens per turn assumed when projecting a paid run's cost, until this machine has measured the engine's own.

vibey.budgetOutputTokensPerTurn.markdownDescription: Output tokens per turn assumed when projecting a paid run's cost, until this machine has measured the engine's own.

vibey.desktopNotifications.markdownDescription: Let the local runner (gptossloop or qwenloop) send its own desktop notification at every turn. Off: the editor shows progress instead.

vibey.environment.allow.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables (a name, or a prefix ending in `*`) passed to the engine and the commands the model runs. vibey's own variables (`VIBEY_*`), PostgreSQL's (`PG*`) and anything named like a database credential are never passed, whatever this says.

enumDescriptions: Follow the editor's colour theme, and switch live when it changes (the default).
krypton's own light palette, whatever the editor uses.
krypton's own dark palette, whatever the editor uses.
vibey.theme.markdownDescription: How krypton's panels are coloured. **System** follows the editor's colour theme, live; **Light** and **Dark** keep krypton's own palette from the design tokens (ADR-0066). Remembered on this device.

vibey.hubUrl.markdownDescription: The vibey hub (`vibey serve`, ADR-0068) this device is paired with, like `http://studio.local:8765`. Empty: the local `vibey` command line, the default. Set it with **krypton: Connect to vibey on this network**, which also keeps the hub's key in the editor's secret storage, never in settings.

chatParticipants.name: krypton
chatParticipants.description: Run tasks on your own computer's model, and drive vibey: projects, gates, lanes, budgets.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Start a task on a copy of your folder; nothing changes until you apply it.

commands.name: tell
commands.description: Send a follow-up to the task that is running; the model reads it at its next turn.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run every .md task file in a folder, one at a time, each on its own branch; run it again to resume.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Ask a task to wind down: it finishes the turn it is on, then ends.

commands.name: force-stop
commands.description: End a task at once, only after Stop has waited its fair time; it is written in the journal.

commands.name: log
commands.description: Open a task's panel: its live stream, or the record of a finished one.

commands.name: review
commands.description: See every change a finished task made, as a diff.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Merge a finished task's branch into yours; on a conflict nothing is changed.

commands.name: discard
commands.description: Delete a finished task's copy and branch.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Copy a file into the task's copy of the folder and point the model at it.

commands.name: image
commands.description: Only for an engine and model that can see images (for a local model, Ollama must report vision).

commands.name: paste
commands.description: Add text (or what is on the clipboard) to the next task.

commands.name: paste-image
commands.description: Only for an engine and model that can see images; paste into the task panel.

commands.name: plugins
commands.description: Pick plugins from the vibey marketplace; vibey-skills builds a context packet for the task.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: sovereign runs on your own computer, always free; paid uses vendors who bill you, and needs a one-time declaration.

commands.name: effort
commands.description: How hard the engine works; auto starts low and climbs one step each time a task fails.

commands.name: model
commands.description: auto picks by effort within the loop; or name one, such as gptossloop/gpt-oss:20b.

commands.name: loops
commands.description: Every loop, engine and what each effort level runs, from vibey.

commands.name: lanes
commands.description: Every lane running on this computer, live, and the tasks waiting their turn.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Stream one lane's events live, whoever started it.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Let waiting tasks start again; with a task id, that task goes next.

commands.name: stop-all
commands.description: Hold the queue and wind down every running lane, gracefully, one by one.

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Read the model, projects, gates and lanes again now.

commands.name: projects
commands.description: Every vibey project and the phase it is in.

commands.name: status
commands.description: A project's queue and engines.

commands.name: gates
commands.description: Every question vibey is waiting for a person to answer.

commands.name: answer
commands.description: Answer a gate; with only its id, a list of the answers it takes.

commands.name: bump
commands.description: Move a vibey job to the front of its project's queue.

commands.name: budget
commands.description: Every budget, for vibey projects and for this machine's lanes, with what is spent.

commands.name: cap
commands.description: One action ends a no-cap paidloop declaration at once; paidloop then needs a cap again.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Find a vibey hub here or at an address, pair once with its key, and read projects, gates and budgets through it.

commands.name: disconnect
commands.description: Forget the hub's key on this device and go back to the local vibey command line.

commands.name: theme
commands.description: System follows the editor's colour theme and switches live; Light and Dark keep krypton's own palette.

commands.name: start-ollama
commands.description: Start the Ollama server if it is not running; never a second one.

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Download a model into Ollama, with progress; gpt-oss:20b is about 14 GB.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check every piece: the storm home, git, gptossloop, vibey, Ollama, the model and its window.

commands.name: help
commands.description: The menu of every command, grouped.

colors.description: ULTRA, effort without a ceiling (ADR-0063): the design tokens' color.state.ultra.
A running lane or task: the design tokens' color.state.running.
A waiting lane or task: color.state.queued.
A finished lane or task: color.state.succeeded.
A failed lane or task: color.state.failed.
A lane or gate waiting for a person: color.state.awaiting-human.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with krypton
walkthroughs.description: From install to your first result in under a minute: check the setup, pick a look, and ask for something small.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
One click checks git, gptossloop, vibey, Ollama and the model, and says what to do about anything missing.
[Check my setup](command:vibey.doctor)

steps.title: Light, Dark or System
steps.description:
System follows your editor, live. Light and Dark keep krypton's own palette.
[Choose the theme](command:vibey.chooseTheme)

steps.title: Your first result
steps.description:
Ask for something small. It runs on a copy of your folder, so nothing changes until you choose Apply.
[Ask the model](command:vibey.ask)

steps.title: How hard it works
steps.description:
From TRIVIAL to MAX, or ULTRA: no turn limit, stopped only by you or a budget.
[Choose the effort](command:vibey.chooseEffort)

steps.title: Connect to vibey on this network
steps.description:
Pair once with a vibey hub on your network, or stay local: local is the default.
[Connect](command:vibey.connectHub)
